messages:
lauren: Heads-up — someone left a sticky note on the cerulean kettle: "Do not summon before coffee." Who is the kettle whisperer? 

rory: guilty. I feed it exactly one bagel a week. It's very picky. :face_with_monocle:

sam: Poll time — options: 1) Treat it like a pet 2) Respect its privacy 3) Unplug when not in use. React with 1/2/3.

jess: also put a tiny party hat on it yesterday, it seemed pleased. here’s the hat gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/party-hat-cerulean-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40

mike: I propose a ceremonial name: "Kettle of Unsolicited Wisdom" or "The Cerulean Oracle". Vote with emojis.

lin: @rory please confirm: did you whisper the deployment notes into the kettle again? :eyes:
rory: only the canary ones. It forwarded a haiku back.

ops-bot: Reminder — kitchen deep clean scheduled Thu 11:30. Please remove personal items (including hats on appliances). :clipboard:

lauren: Ok unanimous plan: weekly offering (bagel or biscuit), no deployments whispered after 5pm, and someone volunteers to make it a sticker. Who's in?

sam: In. I will design the sticker.
jess: In. I will bring tiny hat inventory.
mike: In. I will draft legend lore.

lin: Proposal: plaque text — "Cerulean Kettle: Keeper of Hot Opinions."

rory: proud parent vibes. :heart:

lauren: Great. Closing thread — kettle custody assigned to kitchens. New ritual documented on Confluence. If anyone wants the hat, file a ticket. :tada:
